top_violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Bottles in the toddler's room were not labeled with children's names.

top_violation_types.title: Alternate Activity for Non-sleeping Children (26 TAC §746.2907(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Awaken children were not given an alternative activity during naptime.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The infants did not have infant feeding instructions available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An evacuation diagram was not posted in the multipurpose classroom where PreK and School Age Children were present doing activities.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director posted the evacuation diagram.

top_violation_types.title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not validated the employee list since 7/2/21.

top_violation_types.title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two infants did not have current infant feeding schedules.

top_violation_types.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Sufficient Number of Toys (26 TAC §746.2405(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Room was observed with no toys and furnishing for infants.
